text.text_excerpt: What a cool spot! I had passed this place a few times on my way to Delachaise and always wondered what it was like. It looked small and cozy, so I was eager to check it out. I walked in and I felt welcome immediately. The bar was filled with local "regulars", and although the place is pretty small, I had no issues finding a seat on the side away from the bar itself. They have a few beers on tap and I'm sure more in bottles. I just stuck to getting Bass on tap. My only real complaint was that the place was a bit smoky, because it's small, but if you stay a little while it really isn't that bad.

small bar + super nice staff + great happy hours = a great local place to drink AND have a conversation I am totally surprised that this place isn't on Yelp yet! Its a small pub that has a great happy hour starting at 4:30. I know that Martinis are $3 then but not sure the other deals. I love that there is outdoor seating and you can bring your dog! Really I would go there just for that. Inside is small but nice. There is plenty of seating around the bar and some tables and chairs set of in a smaller attached room. I'm a big fan of this place and come often when I visit friends in the area. Cool decor, clean, never usually crowded. Lots of regulars, but they're friendly. There is a flat screen TV, sometimes low playing music, yet nothing that would disturb you from having friendly conversations with those around you. Brewster, the bartender, is awesome! He always has a good story to tell and is funny. The bathrooms are tiny, but clean and accomodating. Yes, smoking is allowed here. They do a pretty good job of opening the place up when there's good weather so it's never been overly smokey IMO.
